original_ai_output.title_zh: 武装匪首因社区拒绝为其采矿而驱逐扎姆法拉社区居民
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据ICIR报道，尼日利亚扎姆法拉州安卡地方政府区Birnin Doki的居民因拒绝在武装匪首Muhammad Gwaska控制的矿区劳作而遭驱逐。事件发生于10月15日，数十名村民被迫步行约15公里前往安卡镇。村民称过去五天未获政府支持，只能露宿街头、乞讨度日。该报道为单一来源。

location.raw_text: Birnin Doki in the troubled Anka Local Government Area of Zamfara State

key_facts.fact: 武装匪首Muhammad Gwaska因Birnin Doki居民拒绝为其矿区劳作而驱逐当地居民
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Notorious bandit leader Muhammad Gwaska has displaced residents of Birnin Doki in the troubled Anka Local Government Area of Zamfara State after they resisted pressure to work at mining sites under his control.

key_facts.fact: 事件发生于10月15日，数十名村民被迫步行约15公里至安卡镇
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The incident, which occurred on 15 October, saw dozens of villagers forced to walk about a 15-kilometre distance from Birnin Doki to the local government headquarters in Anka town.

key_facts.fact: 村民称过去五天未获政府支持，夜间露宿街头
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: For the past five days, the victims told the ICIR that they had not received any support from the government... At night, many are forced to sleep on the streets.

key_facts.fact: 村民称此前在已故匪首Halilu Sububu控制下被迫劳作，其2024年被尼日利亚军方击毙后由Gwaska接手
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: they had lived under the influence of bandits for more than five years and were forced to work for the bandits, then led by the late Halilu Sububu. Since Sububu was killed by the Nigerian Military in 2024, another bandit leader, Gwaska... has claimed many of the mining fields

uncertainties: 事件细节主要来自村民向ICIR的陈述，目前仅单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
政府是否提供安置与援助的说法仅来自受害村民，未获官方确认
